title: pm-dispatch(runbook): 〈巡查常设项〉 still names the patrol per project, and its cross-account review dedupe is keyed to the account
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Filing gate: ② a should-fix of the contract review on PR #28739 (record 6560664363, ④), outside that PR because its card (#28699) allows no other change. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉 (L39, L44, L45 on `main` at the time of filing).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "每项目巡查" in:body → none; "巡查常设项" → none.
reach: every project that sits more than one seat on one account (this project sits spec seat 4, devx seat 2 and skills seat 2 as `marchtian`).

## What is inconsistent

- After PR #28687 and PR #28739, the skill and its references say one patrol routine **per seat**.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉 heading 「每项目巡查与总监席摘要」 and the line 「跨账户复审:每项目巡查跑 `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review`…」 still say per project.
- The next line's dedupe 「已有他账户的认领即跳过」 is keyed to the account, so two seats of one account in one project both pass it and could double-review one PR.

## Wanted

- 「每项目巡查」 → 「每席巡查」 in the heading and on the cross-account review line.
- The review-claim dedupe on the next line skips a PR already claimed by another **seat** (session), not only another account.
- Net line count 0. Tier S by the register (`.claude/**`).
